statement: (n d : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (hd : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n) : Odd d
proof:
:= by
  have h_dvd_n : d ∣ n := by
    have h₁ : d ∈ properUnitaryDivisors n := hd
    have h₂ : d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n ∧ d ∣ n ∧ d.Coprime (n / d) := by
      simpa [properUnitaryDivisors] using h₁
    exact h₂.2.1
  
  have h_main : Odd d := by
    have h₁ : d ∣ n := h_dvd_n
    have h₂ : Odd n := hn
    have h₃ : ¬Even n := by
      intro h
      have h₄ : Even n := h
      rw [Nat.even_iff] at h₄
      have h₅ : n % 2 = 0 := by omega
      have h₆ : Odd n := hn
      rw [Nat.odd_iff] at h₆
      omega
    have h₄ : ¬Even d := by
      intro h
      have h₅ : Even d := h
      rw [Nat.even_iff] at h₅
      have h₆ : 2 ∣ d := by omega
      have h₇ : 2 ∣ n := dvd_trans h₆ h₁
      have h₈ : Even n := by
        rw [Nat.even_iff]
        omega
      contradiction
    have h₅ : Odd d := by
      rw [Nat.odd_iff]
      have h₆ : ¬Even d := h₄
      have h₇ : ¬(2 ∣ d) := by
        intro h
        have h₈ : Even d := by
          rw [Nat.even_iff]
          omega
        contradiction
      omega
    exact h₅
  
  exact h_main
